maria (PM): Quick design review — rollouts page (canaries / A/B / rollback / history timeline). Uploaded updated frames to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/rollouts-v2 kevin (Design): Thanks — looked at the canary flow. Two high-level asks: 1) make the canary size control more discoverable, 2) timeline needs clearer markers for automatic vs manual rollouts. :eyes: alex (Frontend): Noted. For discoverability I was thinking a persistent small CTA next to the deploy button: "Start canary (preset: 5%)". That avoids hiding the slider in a modal. jamie (Eng-Platform): Prefer the modal for safety but happy to add a visible hint. Can we keep the slider but add a keyboard-friendly stepper (+ / -) and numeric input? omelia (typo) olivia (Accessibility): Small nit: the slider alone is not great for keyboard/screenreader users. Need ARIA labels and visible focus ring. Also contrast on the timeline badges (green/amber/red) fails WCAG for the amber on certain backgrounds. kevin (Design): Good catch. I'll adjust palette and add a fallback icon for color-blind users (triangle/exclamation). Also thinking about microcopy: current rollback confirmation says "Rollback to previous version?" which is vague. Suggest "Rollback to vX.Y — this will revert runtime and config to the selected version. Confirm rollback?" maria (PM): Love the clearer copy. Also product ask: show the reason/notes for a rollback in the timeline event (who clicked, short text). That helps audits. sam (SRE): For canaries we need an inline metric preview: success rate, latency delta, error spike indicator. Ideally a compact sparkline and a red/green small KPI next to the canary row. alex (Frontend): I can render a mini-sparkline svg. Need data contract from backend — jamie, can you expose the short metrics API for the most recent 15m? jamie (Eng-Platform): Yep, adding endpoint /rollouts/:id/preview-metrics (returns last 15m aggregates). Will respect tenant auth. ETA tomorrow. olivia (Accessibility): Also propose visible text alternatives for the canary percentage preset chips (e.g., "5% (small)") so screen reader users immediately know intent. And ensure the timeline nodes are reachable via arrow keys. kevin (Design): UX decision: timeline — collapsed view shows only deploy hashes + status; expand shows notes, metrics snapshot, and rollback button. How should rollback button behave — inline or open a modal? sam (SRE): Modal with an explicit checklist is safer: show affected routes, estimated downtime risk, and a 15s grace countdown before action. Also require a confirmation phrase for prod rollbacks (e.g., type "rollback vX.Y"). maria (PM): For lower envs we can afford inline rollback, but prod must be modal with checklist. Add an A/B test toggle in the UI — copy: "Run A/B test (control vs candidate) — duration, traffic split, metrics to watch". Keep defaults sensible: 50/50 for A/B unless user picks otherwise.\e olivia (Accessibility) kevin (Design): Copy tweaks proposals: - Canary start CTA: "Start canary (5% recommended)" - Rollout state badge: "Canary — 5%", "Gradual rollout — 30%", "Paused" - Rollback CTA: "Rollback to v3.4 (opens modal)" with small link "Why rollback? Add note" alex (Frontend): Will implement the badge text and aria-labels. Question: should badge be clickable to open history anchored to that version? maria (PM): Yes, clicking a badge should jump to that version in the timeline panel. Good for quick triage. kevin (Design): Accessibility nits: timeline node hit area is small on mobile. Increase to 44px min. Also ensure color + icon combination for status. olivia (Accessibility): Also test with VoiceOver: timeline summary should read like: "v3.4 — canary 5% — 3m running — no errors detected". Here is a quick ARIA example for a timeline item:
jamie (Eng-Platform): Backend will include friendly summary in the API to avoid building sentences in the client. Sending fields: version, status_label, runtime_minutes, brief_metrics. sam (SRE): One more operational ask: add auto-fallback policy display next to A/B/canary controls. If the canary crosses error threshold X within Y minutes, auto-rollback should trigger and show the reason in timeline. UI should make policy editable.\kevin (Design): UI for policies could be a small gear icon next to the canary row that opens policy editor. Keep it compact. maria (PM): Decision list: - Keep visible canary CTA but open modal on click for safety (modal contains keyboard steppers). - Timeline: collapsed/expanded nodes with metrics snapshot + notes. Clicking badge anchors timeline. - Rollback: modal for prod with confirmation phrase; inline for non-prod. - Accessibility: add ARIA labels, keyboard controls, 44px hit targets, contrast + icons. - Operational: mini-metrics preview + editable auto-fallback policy. kevin (Design): I'll push a new Figma file with these changes by EOD. Please leave :eyes: or :+1: reactions. deploy-bot: New design review noted for thread 1748001234 — page: rollouts-v2 — reviewers: kevin,alex,olivia — checklist created. maria (PM): Thanks all. After Kevin updates Figma, Alex can pick up the frontend tasks. Jamie will wire APIs. Olivia will run quick a11y smoke test. We'll sync Friday 10am if anything blocking. kevin (Design): Added frame with updated palette and icons. Left comments on the canary modal re: copy. alex (Frontend): Picking this up. Filing PR branch: feat/rollouts-ui-canary. I'll ping when prototype deployed to staging. sam (SRE): When staging deploys, please tag me so I can run the load + chaos smoke. olivia (Accessibility): I'll queue a quick NVDA / VoiceOver pass once staging is up. maria (PM): Great — closing thread for now. Please @maria if blockers appear.
__comment: This JSON is a single Slack thread document. All fields are strings or list of strings as required. No title field included.
